description: 국가철도공단 도시광역철도 수도권 2호선 역명 [railways and stations] (series on Public Data Portal (data.go.kr)) is a series of datasets listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 명칭을 말한다. ① 노선명 및 역명 표기문자는 한글로 최대 6자 이내로 정하는 것을 원칙으로 하되, 5자 이상으로 정할 경우에는 4자 이내의 축약 역명까지 동시에 정하여야 한다. ② 철도시설관리자. Coverage: South Korea. The portal lists 11 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 2호선, 역명, 지하철역명, 노선명, 도시광역철도. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2026-08-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
